subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw standardize skill runtime data as a new filesystem directory contract, a plugin or SQLite-backed state API, or ClawHub authoring guidance without new core runtime behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing a durable storage owner changes public skill metadata, user filesystem layout, sandbox expectations, backup behavior, and future compatibility, which requires maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Approve a storage design first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer design choice before any fix PR adds metadata fields or creates new directories.

options.title: Prefer plugin/state APIs
options.body: Route persistent skill-owned state toward existing plugin/runtime SQLite-backed storage surfaces and document when plain SKILL.md skills should avoid filesystem state.

options.title: Add a filesystem convention
options.body: Create a documented `~/.openclaw/data/skills/<slug>` style contract with install-time creation, validation, docs, and migration or doctor expectations.

recommendation.title: Approve a storage design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer design choice before any fix PR adds metadata fields or creates new directories.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across skills lifecycle, skill docs, plugin SDK/state, and storage-boundary work.
